jobs.title: Public notice regarding result for the post of Process Server (selection of candidate from the Ex-servicemen category)
jobs.details: Nagar/ 18/08/2026 Member Secretary (I/c) OFFICE ORDER In reference to Public Notice No.09/PULSA/2026 as to declaration of final result against 22 posts of process servers, one post falling under Ex-serviceman (woman) category could not be filled due to non -availability of candidate. Accordingly, in light of instructions issued by Government of Punjab and Punjab Civil Services (Reservation of posts for woman) Rules 2020, below mentioned candidate from waiting list of male Ex -servicemen (self) category has been selected as per order of merit:- Roll No. Name of the Candidate Category wise order of merit Station allotted 09210 Rajwinder Singh 2nd in Ex -servicemen category Permanent Lok Adalat
